extraction.Name: Rose Ross (Carpenter)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 12, 1918, by William Ross
extraction.Buyer: Rose Ross Carpenter and William Carpenter conveyed the land by deed to Irene Huggins Ross for $1.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612796 issued; Northwest quarter section 1, township 95, north of range 77; receipt for patent signed February 14, 1918, by the allottee; conveyance dated June 12, 1918
